skill.name: open-kimi-ppt
skill.usageExample: 把这份调研报告做成一份 12 页的演示文稿，交付可编辑源文件和 PPTX。

description.zh: 创建、编辑、复刻、读取和导出演示文稿。任何 PPT 任务默认同时交付两份产物：(1) 自包含的 PPTD 工程目录（.pptd 清单 + pages/media 等依赖）；(2) 本地生成的 .pptx（内嵌字体、淡入翻页效果）。适用于演示文稿、PowerPoint、PPT/PPTX、幻灯片、信息图、海报等任务，除非用户明确指定其他格式。交付时使用绝对路径的本地文件/目录链接。
description.en: Create, edit, replicate, read, and export presentations. For every PPT task, the default deliverables are BOTH (1) a self-contained PPTD project folder containing the .pptd manifest plus pages/media dependencies and (2) a locally generated .pptx with embedded fonts and fade slide transitions. Use for any presentation, PowerPoint, PPT/PPTX, slide deck, PPTD, infographic, or poster task unless the user explicitly requests another format. Deliver with normal local file/folder links using absolute paths.
